title.zh: Crypto casino Duelbits goes offline after $7 million hot wallet hack
title.en: Crypto casino Duelbits goes offline after $7 million hot wallet hack

current_state.zh: Crypto casino Duelbits took its site offline after attackers drained about $7 million from its hot wallets across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Tron and Bitcoin, with roughly $6 million in stolen funds consolidated into a single Ethereum address holding ~2,234 ETH.
current_state.en: Crypto casino Duelbits took its site offline after attackers drained about $7 million from its hot wallets across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Tron and Bitcoin, with roughly $6 million in stolen funds consolidated into a single Ethereum address holding ~2,234 ETH.
